title: TessNova Telemetry Message Contract (Proposed)
description: Standardized bedside monitor ECG telemetry published over MQTT. Proposed format for team agreement.

device_id.description: Non-empty alphanumeric identifier for the bedside device.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for replay and gap detection.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds at message generation.

ecg.description: ECG reading in bpm or millivolts.
